request.query: Roth theorem index lemma numerical bound dyadic real power delta 1 plus reciprocal dimension

items.name: ThreeAPFree.le_rothNumberNat
items.type: ∀ {k n : ℕ} (s : Finset ℕ), ThreeAPFree ↑s → (∀ x ∈ s, x < n) → s.card = k → k ≤ rothNumberNat n

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux
items.type: ∀ {n d : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → 2 ≤ n → ↑d ^ (n - 2) / ↑n ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: Behrend.bound_aux'
items.type: ∀ (n d : ℕ), ↑(d ^ n) / ↑(n * d ^ 2) ≤ ↑(rothNumberNat ((2 * d - 1) ^ n))

items.name: addRothNumber_le
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_2} [inst : DecidableEq α] [inst_1 : AddMonoid α] (s : Finset α), addRothNumber s ≤ s.card

items.name: rothNumberNat_add_le
items.type: ∀ (M N : ℕ), rothNumberNat (M + N) ≤ rothNumberNat M + rothNumberNat N
